A clear process.

03

A few good questions.

Can I request changes to the logo or concept?

Absolutely! Your feedback helps refine the agreed direction, and each package includes revision rounds. A completely new direction or changes beyond the agreed scope can be quoted separately.

Why do you only provide one concept?

We explore two moodboard routes first, so we can agree on a direction before designing. Then I develop one considered identity around your brand and refine it with you through the included revision rounds.

What types of files will I receive?

Your handover includes the final files and brand guidance listed in your selected package. We’ll confirm the print, digital and editable formats you need in your proposal, so you know exactly what to expect.

How many revisions are included?

The Essentials includes 2 revision rounds, The Next Step includes 3, and The All-in-One includes 4. Packaging includes up to 3 rounds. Extra revisions can be quoted separately.

What if I need more brand elements?

We can build a custom scope around what your brand needs. Tell me which extra elements you have in mind, and I’ll confirm the additional cost and timeline before we begin.

What if I only need one part of a service (like just a logo)?

Tell me what you’re looking for through the enquiry form. We’ll explore your goals and find a suitable scope, with the deliverables, price and timeline agreed before booking.

What should I have ready?

Your brand story, goals, ideal timeline and any hard deadlines. Packaging projects also need final dielines, dimensions, product information and printer requirements.

What’s outside the package?

Font licences, printing, manufacturing, photography, stock assets and third-party costs are excluded unless included in your proposal. Extra revisions and deliverables can be quoted separately.

How do payments and timelines work?

A signed contract and 50% advance confirm your slot. The balance is due before final files. Timelines depend on scope, availability, feedback and supplied content, and are confirmed before booking.
